labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected behaviour (possible deadlock) with stack dumps; no runnable reproduction.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No minimal runnable example; maintainer needs one to reproduce.

items.body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. Labelling this as a bug that needs more information before a maintainer can look at it. Stack dumps and a lock-order theory are helpful, but they are not a reproduction the maintainer can run.

Could you add a minimal runnable example that reproduces the deadlock with `Live(..., redirect_stdout=True, redirect_stderr=True, auto_refresh=True)` and a thread or task that prints or logs during refresh? Please also include the Rich version and platform, and the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
